```{r echo=FALSE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
sim_results_path="/Users/davidquaresma/Desktop/repos/faas-simulator/sim_results/generator/baseline/"

  sim_results_path,

baseline_inf_input$responseTimeToEvaluate = calculate_responseTimeToEvaluate(baseline_inf_input)$responseTimeToEvaluate
baseline_15min_input$responseTimeToEvaluate = calculate_responseTimeToEvaluate(baseline_15min_input)$responseTimeToEvaluate


sim_results_path="/Users/davidquaresma/Desktop/repos/faas-simulator/sim_results/generator/simplehr/"

  sim_results_path,
  "simplehr_idletimeINF_tlprobp95-invocations.csv", sep="")
)

  "simplehr_idletime900.0_tlprobp95-invocations.csv", sep="")

rm(sim_results_path)
```

# Plot Arrivals Rate
```{r echo=FALSE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
functions_to_plot <- c(
  "constant-bernoulli-func",
  "constant-logNormal-func"
  #"constant-weibull-func"
)
titles <- c(
  "bernoulli",
  "logNormal"
  #"constant-weibull func"
)

for (i in 1:length(functions_to_plot)) {
  generated_input_filtered = filter(generated_input, func == functions_to_plot[i])
  print(plot_requests_workload(generated_input_filtered, title=paste("Invocations for Function ", titles[i], sep="")))
}
rm(generated_input_filtered)
```

# Histograms for Latency:
## Sanity Tests comparing generated traces (Bernoulli & LogNormal) to simulated baseline at idletime INF
```{r echo=FALSE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
for (i in 1:length(functions_to_plot)) {
  selected_function = functions_to_plot[i]
  call_histograms(
    filter(generated_input, func == selected_function)$duration,
    filter(baseline_inf_input, funcID == selected_function)$responseTimeToEvaluate,
    paste(titles[i], "trace input", sep=" "),
    paste(titles[i], "baseline sim", sep=" "),
    "Generated vs Simulated: Sanity Check",
    c("#53B0E6", "#FFB86B", "#0000CC", "#CC5500", "darkblue", "saddlebrown")
  )
}
rm(selected_function)
```

## Simulated: SimpleHR vs Baseline with idletime as INF
